title: Re: Ratsputin's Nesting Dolls: Ice Whiskers
description: Re: Ratsputin's Nesting Dolls: Ice Whiskers — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Audrey the Alchemist

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Slay the Ice Whisker Nesting Dolls in the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing A, off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 1 in Level 3 of Ratsputin's Gulag, then return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Audrey the Alchemist

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Slay the Ice Whisker Nesting Dolls in the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing A, off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 1 in Level 3 of Ratsputin's Gulag, then return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Offer:

Well, unfortunately, research by annihilation takes time. Fortunately it won't be taking my precious time, just yours. If you keep up with researching/annihilating the Ice Whisker Nesting Dolls then you are bound to discover the mystery of how they are able to be stored in one another. Maybe you will even discover why Ratsputin locked them so deep inside his Gulag.

Head back into Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing A which, you know by now, is off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 1 in Level 3 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Again you must seek out and slay the Ice Whisker Nesting Dolls. Be prepared, this fight is unlike any you have faced before. Hmmm...I doesn't sound quite as dramatic this time. Finish up your research by annihilation then return to me, Audrey the Alchemist, in Townston.

Turn-in:

What have you learned? Well, I think we already knew that they dropped loot. Let me know when you are ready to do more research.

Objectives:

  • Slay Ice Whisker Blaster Nesting Doll
  • Slay Ice Whisker Seer Nesting Doll
  • Slay Ice Whisker Spitter Nesting Doll
  • Slay Ice Whisker Blademaster Nesting Doll
  • Slay Ice Whisker Broodling Nesting Doll

Level range: 85–100
